answer.reason: The verses only name the river of Egypt as a boundary marker or the limit of a territory, and nothing happened at it or to it.
doubts: 2KI 24:7 and ISA 27:12 mention it only as an extent or limit, not an event of the place itself.
EZK 47:19 and EZK 48:28 say only 'the river', which is a boundary description.
